_about: Signature (Premium Monologue, BETA): the '$80 edit' talking-head style rebuilt for ordinary phone/webcam footage. A new picture every 0.6-1.6 s (face / punch / meaning cutaway / type card), word-cluster typography (tiny lead-ins, ONE huge hero, serif-italic accent), a hook burst of rapid swaps, a sound on every move, warm rich grade, emotional piano bed. See engine/docs/templates/premium-signature/VERSIONS.md. Self-contained: it carries phantasic main's monologue.json, which is newer than the fork's own monologue (no look.refocus, look.target, cadence.targetPerMin). music.optional because silent-descent is not shipped.

director.style: A cinematic quote edit: the speaker carries it, cutaways are METAPHORS for the line (never literal stock of the word), typography is the hero.
director.context: Read the whole transcript first and write build/context.json (topic, audience, glossary of what terms mean in THIS video). Cutaway searches come from the meaning: 'clarity problem' -> fog; 'a lot of CEOs and companies' -> a night skyline; 'AI is here' -> dawn.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one hero per phrase (the word that carries the line). captions.serif: 1-3 heroes drawn in the serif. captions.script: 1-2 small words written in handwriting. captions.stairs: [[from,to]] for one short line (3-5 words) set as a diagonal staircase.
director.cutaways: 3-4 image scenes per 15 s (scene kind image, src assets/stock/<pick>.jpg from stock_fetch.py, public domain / CC0 only), 0.8-1.8 s, captions: true so the cluster sits on the picture. One concept card (kind concept: word + 3-4 engravings) on the first key noun.
director.transitions: One leak beat (0.35-0.45 s) into a return to the speaker; one image enters with in: glitch.
